success.support_requirement: both exact forearm cylinder colliders in contact and each upward force > 1e-6 N; at most 0.12 seconds continuous contact loss including startup (not two additive windows). Hand-end spheres may touch as auxiliary contact but do not count as forearm support
success.disallowed_support: any payload contact with floor, torso or other robot geometry fails immediately; only the two forearm cylinders and their left/right_hand_end_collision spheres are permitted

notes: All members run the same seeds and conditions. Member labels do not change physics.
Zero requested load uses a documented 1 gram positive-inertia numerical proxy.
Mass changes require a new environment; never change only a label or stale inertial tensor.
This is the no-push baseline protocol. Add a versioned protocol before claiming disturbance-recovery results.
A quick smoke evaluation is not the 50-episode/20-second proposal evaluation.
The 80 percent goal in the proposal is not an achieved result.
